speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have fatigue, difficulty concentrating, and abnormal blood findings. To understand what is going on, have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or dark urine recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the detailed history. Given your digital pain that improves with cold, do your fingertips ever develop white or blue discoloration before turning red? Also, have you noticed any significant weight loss or night sweats recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and difficulty to concentrate. I also have Dyspnea on exertion, Dizziness, Digital pain that improves with cold.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Raynaud's Phenomenon secondary to Undifferentiated Connective Tissue Disease (likely Early Systemic Sclerosis or Mixed Connective Tissue Disease).

REQUEST TEST: ANA, Anti-centromere, Anti-RNP, ESR, CRP, CBC with differential, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel.
REQUEST IMAGES: Capillaroscopy of nail fold.
